checked_obligation: Verify that continuity of f and Z(f)=f^{-1}({0}) imply that Z(f) is closed in X.
reason: The predecessor establishes Z(f)=f^{-1}({0}), and {0} is closed in R. Since f:X→R is continuous, the inverse image of every closed subset of R is closed in X; hence Z(f) is closed. The supplied group-theoretic rules are inapplicable and unnecessary.
